notes.title: One day before the release of the Swordbreaker prequel!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10709381/8b43c3e95149ea35d11d5690748f7eb9eb4b78b4.jpg[/img]

Hello, friends!
We are glad to inform you that there is literally one day left before the release of the game! Tomorrow you will be able to dive into the fascinating past of Swordbreaker, and maybe even create a new future for him!)

All the last days we have been checking and testing the game, as well as creating additional content for the store: DLC with all the game's art and a set of soundtracks! I think you'll like it!

Be sure to add to the vishlist! This is important!)
Hot days are starting!
One day before the release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080700/Swordbreaker_Origins/

notes.title: Release of our Trivia Quiz: All about everything!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10709381/c10ad763fa40c670c07ff5c7f153636f732fbe72.jpg[/img]
Hurray! Release!
Our educational and developing game Quiz is already available in Steam!
In it you can test your knowledge in different game modes and on different topics. Learn a lot about everything in the world) compete With other players and get achievements!
The game comes out with a new theme - the Story!
In honor of the release, the game has a discount! Take it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/905150/Trivia_Quiz_All_about_everything/

notes.title: Release Swordbreaker The Game on the Android!
notes.notes:
The long-awaited event has come true!
Our game Swordbreaker The Game came to PlayMarket open spaces: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details? id=com.swordbreaker2.game.android
Now all owners of devices on the basis of the Android OS can play it. We long reflected on that to make game paid or free and have stopped on paid option.
In game achievements also work.
[IMG]http://s020.radikal.ru/i711/1605/ed/23717fab0b84.png[/IMG]

notes.title: First patch
notes.notes:
So here it is! Some bugs fixed: 
 - grammar mistakes
 - chief crash (eng version)
 - falcon crash (eng version)
 - Don't touch Gans achivment fixed
 + added change screen mode option in main menu

Some bugs are still in progress: 
 - wrong display on some resolutions (you can play through using windowed mode in full screen right now, it works well)
 - some users have problems with run on 32-bit systems.

Итак первый пакет исправлений вышел: 
 - поправлены некоторые грамматические ошибки
 - исправлены вылеты в английской версии
 - исправлен баг с получением достижения "Не трожь Ганса!"
 + добавлен режим игры в окне, для тех, у кого имеются проблемы с разрешением экрана.
